fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics achieved Q3 operating profit of KRW 107.4 trillion, becoming the first Korean company to exceed KRW 100 trillion in quarterly operating profit, surpassing records of major tech companies such as NVIDIA and Apple
fields.summary_ko.1: Daishin Securities forecasts that the semiconductor boom will continue at a steeper and longer pace driven by concurrent growth in general-purpose DRAM and HBM
